text:
mara_marketing: quick ask for the launch page: marketing wants a small, reproducible perf pack we can link — headline numbers + a compact artifact bundle. can runtime produce a public summary and an internal dump?

sam_runtime: yes. define headline vs dump. headline should be tiny (p50, p95, cost/1k tokens) + a 1-line method blurb. dump = raw traces, percentiles, payloads, and machine spec.

mara_marketing: exactly. headline must compare fp16 vs quantized (4bit) for the same model. also need a short reproducible command we can paste in docs.

sam_runtime: propose: model=redwood-open-7b, N=500 per slice, warmup=100, seed=42, batch=8. quant modes: fp16 and 4bit-static. we'll produce: marketing-summary.json (public) and runtime-artifacts.tar.gz (private).

kai_bench: add a randomized 5% holdout that's run after the main sweep and a tiny long-context slice (1% at 8k tokens) to show tail behavior. also record variance across 3 independent runs for sanity.

jess_pipeline: I'll wire automated uploads to gs://redwood-marketing/launch-pack-v1/. public files get marketing-read; private store goes to gs://redwood-internal/bench-launch-1765441111/ with signed urls. I'll set CI to publish on successful smoke.

leo_product: messaging: please avoid absolute language. suggested blurb: "Median latency measured over 500 runs per slice after 100 warmup requests; quantized figures use static 4-bit quantization on the same infra." good?

mara_marketing: good. legal will still glance but that's safe.

sam_runtime: here's the tiny repro snippet to include in docs (we'll also attach manifest and metadata):

```bash
# example: run on the perf cluster
./tools/bench_run \\n  --model redwood-open-7b \\n  --iters 500 \\n  --batch 8 \\n  --warmup 100 \\n  --seed 42 \\n  --quant fp16,4bit_static \\n  --payloads gs://redwood-marketing/launch-pack-v1/payloads.json \\n  --out gs://redwood-marketing/launch-pack-v1/runs/1765441111/
```

sam_runtime: metadata we'll include: gpu model, CUDA version, driver, docker image, exact git commit of runtime, and a checksum of payloads. add a note: runs are single-GPU, no cross-node batching.

kai_bench: sanity expectations for README:
- same-seed reproduction median within 3%
- p95 stability: repeated runs within 12% unless environment changed
- quantized warmup must mirror fp16 warmup steps
- holdout runs executed last and not used for tuning

jess_pipeline: CI kicked off: perf/1765441111 -> upload in progress. I'll post signed urls when ready.

deploybot: CI job perf/1765441111 started: https://ci.redwood.ai/bench/1765441111

mara_marketing: timeline: need public marketing-summary.json and one sample run link by EOD Tuesday. full deep-artifacts next-day. can you hit that?

sam_runtime: yes for smoke summary by EOD Tuesday. full artifacts & variance runs by Wednesday. I'll tag the runs and include a README.md with checks.

mara_marketing: final checklist (copy to the launch task):
1) marketing-summary.json (p50, p95, cost/1k tokens fp16 vs 4bit)
2) doc-friendly repro snippet (pasteable)
3) payloads.json + payload checksums
4) runtime-artifacts.tar.gz (traces, percentile-table.csv, metadata.json)
5) 5% holdout & 1% long-context slice included
6) signed urls and bucket ACLs set

sam_runtime: noted. will also add a short note in the README about known nondeterminism sources (GPU clocks, small driver jitter) so marketing has context.

mara_marketing: perfect. once the summary is live i'll draft the launch post and share for signoff. thanks all :rocket:
